description: Source code for the 'Prospect' doctype in ERPNext, including class definition, methods for linking/unlinking leads, and functions to create Customer and Opportunity documents from Prospect data.

classes.name: Prospect
classes.description: Represents the Prospect doctype with methods for lifecycle events and linking logic.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Loads address and contact information when the Prospect document is loaded.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the document, updating lead details.

methods.name: on_update
methods.description: Links Prospect with Lead contact and address upon update.

methods.name: on_trash
methods.description: Unlinks dynamic links when the Prospect is deleted.

methods.name: update_lead_details
methods.description: Updates Prospect lead rows with latest Lead information.

methods.name: link_with_lead_contact_and_address
methods.description: Creates links between Prospect and Lead documents.

methods.name: unlink_dynamic_links
methods.description: Removes links associated with the Prospect.
